checklist: docs/roadmap/tasks/N05-promote-accepted-stages.md (N05.3); Q21's report: promotion needs a preregistered N05-style measurement on at least 3 boards

noise_why: canary-pwr 10 (N02: the canary-pwr variants' spread, as every N05 registration); the other rows max(2, ceil(5 % of connections)), connections = pad-to-pad connections of the board (sum over nets of pads - 1, pcbnew 10.0.7 on the files hashed below, counted before any arm ran): mydevboard 130 -> 7, vfo-controller 113 -> 6, flight-computer 98 -> 5, ch32v003 74 -> 4, solarmeshtastic 102 -> 6, cc1101-module 43 -> 3. engine: freerouting-rs release CLI of main 980fd6a, one Linux build for both arms (cargo build --release -p freerouting-cli -p freerouting-dev in the detached worktree target/orchestrator/n05pe/eng, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/orchestrator/n05pe/target, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; its sha256 in the done note); the plugin of the same worktree (kicad-plugin/headless_run.py); KiCad 10.0.7

enhanced.command: ulimit -v 8000000; timeout -k 10 LIMIT tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh --out OUT/enhanced/BOARD --export plugin OUT/enhanced.options.json PROJECT -- ENGINE -de {DSN} -do {SES} --gui.enabled=false -mp 1 --router.scoring.start_ripup_costs=1500
enhanced.what: baseline: the plugin's default enhanced run (its export fix-ups, sweep, keepouts and Board Setup minimums as the plugin passes them), one routing pass and rip-up start cost 1500 for time (as Q21.4); no pin escape

enhanced+pin_escape.command: as enhanced with OUT/enhanced+pin_escape.options.json and --out OUT/enhanced+pin_escape/BOARD
enhanced+pin_escape.what: candidate: enhanced plus the plugin's pin-escape checkbox, which passes --router.fanout.pin_escape=straight

boards.eligibility: decided from the inputs before any route: a row is eligible when the board has a part freerouting_krt::fanout::qfn::qualifying_parts qualifies (X10's frame analysis: 4 or 2 opposite edge rows, at least 8 side pins, pitch at most 0.65 mm), measured by `cargo test --release -p freerouting-krt --test qfn_escape qualifying_parts_on_a_set -- --ignored` (load only, no routing) on the 30 corpus projects' prepped DSNs, the plugin-exported DSNs of the 18 KiCad 10.0.7 demo boards and canary-pwr's: 23 of the 30 corpus projects, 9 of the 18 demo boards and canary-pwr qualify. The rows are the eligible KiCad 6+ projects (own .kicad_pro) that are small enough to route in about 2 minutes or less per arm (at most 310 pad-to-pad connections, from the connection counts below, and a qualifying part of 10 or more side pins at 0.5 mm or finer, or canary-pwr's). Every row listed is run; none is dropped after a number

mydevboard-rp2040dev.qualifying_parts: U1 56 pins at 0.4 mm, J1 20 at 0.5 mm

canary-pwr.qualifying_parts: U1 38 pins at 0.5 mm, U3 10 at 0.5 mm, U6 and U8 8 at 0.65 mm

flight-computer-core-board.qualifying_parts: U5 28 pins at 0.5 mm, U4 8 at 0.65 mm

ch32v003-usb-devboard-ch32v003-usb-devbo.qualifying_parts: U3 20 pins at 0.4 mm, J1 20 at 0.5 mm

boards.why: mydevboard (U1 RP2040 QFN-56 at 0.4 mm) and canary-pwr (U1 at 0.5 mm) are Q21.4's two rows, whose result (57 -> 44 and 52 -> 51) is why the option exists; the five others are KiCad projects with a qualifying part that Q21 did not route (seen_before_registration). Paths are relative to the main checkout's root (read only); the canary row is canary's hardware/canary-pwr-rev1.0 at 9511d9a3 (target/orchestrator/q21/canary-pwr-9511d9a3, written by `git -C ../canary show 9511d9a3:hardware/canary-pwr-rev1.0/<file>`)

grading: every route inside tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh --export plugin (the plugin's export and fix-ups, the router flags it passes with the Board Setup minimums, its SES import; KiCad 10.0.7 DRC under the project's own rules); one KiCad grade per distinct session: when the two arms' sessions on a row are byte-identical the baseline's grade is used for both and the second grade is discarded unread; kicad-cli only while `pgrep -a kicad-cli` shows none, one at a time; vias in pads by tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py on the routed board
limits: ulimit -v 8000000 on every route; timeout -k 10 on the whole grade.sh call, 600 s for canary-pwr and 120 s for the other rows; a run that hits its limit is recorded as aborted = 1 and TIMEOUT and is not graded or rerun; an arm with an aborted route is not accepted

metric_definitions.via_in_pad, below_minimum, manufacturing: hard guards, no new breach versus baseline (decided 2026-10-18: no registration carries a hard guard the baseline already breaks): the arm's raw count minus the enhanced arm's raw count on the same row, floored at 0, so 0 in the enhanced arm by definition; the raw counts are reported as <name>_raw, and the report says whether each is 0 in both arms (expected: Q21.4 measured 0 in both arms on both its rows)
metric_definitions.via_in_pad_raw: tools/kicad-oracle/via_in_pad.py's vias_in_pads on the routed board
metric_definitions.below_minimum_raw: the summary's copper.below_minimum track_width + via_diameter + via_drill (copper under the Board Setup minimums, counted from the routed board's geometry)
metric_definitions.manufacturing_breaches_raw: the sum of the routing-caused KiCad items (summary drc_real_by_type) of the manufacturing rule types: clearance, copper_edge_clearance, hole_clearance, hole_to_hole, holes_co_located, track_width, via_diameter, annular_width, drill_out_of_range, microvia_drill_out_of_range, shorting_items, tracks_crossing, solder_mask_bridge, items_not_allowed; the other routing-caused types (via_dangling, track_dangling, starved_thermal and the rest) are reported in drc_real by type, not judged
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: summary unconnected_items of the routed board
metric_definitions.unrouted: the router's final unrouted count (its log's last `final score: ... (N unrouted`), reported
metric_definitions.connections: pad-to-pad connections of the board as counted in boards.rows
metric_definitions.drc_real: summary drc_real, every routing-caused type (starved_thermal included)
metric_definitions.aborted: 1 when the route hit its ulimit -v 8000000 or its timeout, else 0

keep_rule: N02's totals rule with accept no-regress, the other N05 registrations' form: freerouting-dev gate --prereg passes (0 refusals; every hard metric 0; the kicad_unconnected total not worse than the enhanced arm's by more than the set's noise; no board worse than twice its band; no aborted route) AND the candidate's kicad_unconnected total is lower than the enhanced arm's (change < 0; the stage exists to win connections back, so a tie does not promote it). Then router.fanout.pin_escape = straight joins ENHANCED. Otherwise the option stays off in both profiles and the verdict is recorded in N05.3. The plugin's checkbox and the CLI key stay either way.
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per row; no reruns with other settings; a timed-out route is recorded (aborted = 1) and not rerun
seen_before_registration: Q21.4 (engine 6b59998 plus Q21.2-Q21.3, before Q20's output check) routed mydevboard-rp2040dev (off 57, straight 44 KiCad unconnected; 0 breaches) and canary-pwr 9511d9a3 (off 52, straight 51; 0 breaches), both arms, same flags. No other row has been routed with pin_escape = straight. Routes without it exist for flight-computer-core-board (Q17.4: 5 KiCad unconnected, 0.36 s) at older engines; none of the others has a number in this registration's form. The implementer routed nothing before this registration
not_registered: pin_escape as anything but straight (it has no other value)
the optimizer, more passes or the plugin's full default (-mp unset), for time
boards over about 2 minutes per arm (CM5_MINIMA_3, tinytapeout-demo, RoyalBlue54L-Feather, jetson, vme-wren, video)

rows the gate's eligibility did not qualify (no part at a pitch of at most 0.65 mm with 8 side pins): eprom-card-80bus, macroprocessor-diode-matrix-rom-dip, mccx11, pcie-active-backplane, pcietest, picodebugger, slice-dcmt-bread-slice, interf_u, pic_programmer and the other demos listed by the eligibility run

decision_table.accepted: N05 adds fanout.pin_escape = "straight" to ENHANCED (settings/profile.rs) with this measurement, a DIVERGENCES 'Profile enhanced' line, the profile test, a line under archived Q21
decision_table.rejected: the option stays off in both profiles; the verdict goes in N05.3

timing: registered after the release CLI of main 980fd6a was built and the eligibility run measured, before any route of either arm on any row
